title: CFTC Opens U.S. Stock Market to Equity Perpetual Futures
summary: Bitcoin Magazine CFTC Opens U.S. Stock Market to Equity Perpetual Futures The CFTC has cleared perpetual futures on individual stocks to trade on dual-registered U.S. exchanges for the first time. This post CFTC Opens U.S. Stock Market to Equity Perpetual Futures first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
